boundary: Membership access is being prepared. No payment should be taken until checkout, delivery, cancellation and account-access systems are live and verified.

tiers.name: Supporter
tiers.summary: A low-cost way to support the project and receive the core weekly member layer.
benefits: Early access to selected free reports
Member archive of published weekly briefs
Supporter updates on new investigations and releases
Access to supporter-only announcements and surveys

tiers.name: Intelligence Member
tiers.summary: The complete day-to-day intelligence layer for readers who want the full evidence-led system.
benefits: Full card intelligence and card evidence notes
Member-only timelines, maps and investigation routes
Downloadable PDF and CSV member releases
Early access to new intelligence tools and reports

tiers.name: Research Pro
tiers.summary: The advanced research and export layer for investigators, writers and serious public-record researchers.
includes: Everything in Intelligence Member and Supporter
benefits: Advanced public-record search and research filters
Advanced Data Laboratory presets and exports
Evidence Archive citation and bibliography exports
Early beta access to new research tools
Downloadable research bundles in PDF, CSV and JSON where available
tiers.requestBoundary: Priority requests enter a review queue. They do not guarantee that a record exists, can be lawfully obtained, or will support a requested conclusion.
